runtime_boundary: exact two-phase NPC item-effect admission and completion ownership
behavior: living NPC and exact NPC-owned carried/equipped item required
nonblank target and explicit authority required
one active item-effect request per NPC instance
successful effect completion consumes item through RuntimeItemEngine.UseNpc

world_state_impact: NPC metadata and NPC-owned item state are persisted by their established owners.
